name: Network Request Diagnosis
description: Use the shared Browser session's failed requests to tell a frontend bug from an API, CORS, auth, DNS, TLS, or server failure.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read failed network requests captured in the session.
See the page URL those requests belong to.
Open the page so the session can record requests.
Compare one URL from outside the page. This is not UI proof.

validation.rule: A failed or blocked request from browser_console_errors or browser_evidence is cited, and the reply names frontend, API, CORS, auth, DNS, TLS, or server only when that evidence supports it.
